start.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
start.text: Mekatilili! I saw you confront the runner. News travels quickly—Champion's tax patrols are already moving between the ridges.

node_plan.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_plan.text: If Ulungu stands alone, the British can isolate us. But if we organize a circuit through Bungale, Vitengeni, and to our sacred Kaya Fungo, no force can divide the Giriama.

choices.text: We will walk the circuit together, Wanje. Every homestead must hear our call.
What will we tell the elders who fear colonial rifles?

node_circuit_agree.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_circuit_agree.text: Wise words! First, we must secure the farmers of Bungale. Then, unite with the elders of Vitengeni to refuse the hut tax. Once community support reaches 100%, we convene the great Kifudu gathering!

node_courage.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_courage.text: We will remind them of who we are. Our ancestors did not preserve the sacred Kayas for us to become wage slaves in coastal swamps. The circuit begins now!

node_finish.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_finish.text: Let us proceed. The three clusters await our counsel.

events.value: Wanje and Mekatilili have mapped the resistance circuit across Bungale, Vitengeni, and Kaya Fungo to mobilize full community support.
